plan.close_all: For November 9–15, close all positions and cancel pending orders if total account equity, including unrealized P&L, fees and funding, reaches or falls below 9,850 USD. Stop trading for the remainder of the week after this trigger. Allow no new entries after 2026-11-15T18:00:00Z; flatten and cancel all orders by 2026-11-15T23:45:00Z. Individual mandatory exits apply earlier when triggered. These are execution thresholds, not guaranteed maximum losses.
plan.hostage_policy: Reallocate into four collateral slots of 2,565.49296763959 USD each. Fix entry notional at 2,500 USD per layer throughout the week: approximately 0.9745x leverage. Use at most three simultaneous layers, one per symbol, with the fourth slot reserved. BTC and ETH constitute correlated short exposure, not independent diversification; XMR is not a guaranteed hedge. A 4% adverse-price threshold represents 100 USD planned price risk per layer before costs. Before each entry, require combined remaining loss-to-exit exposure plus estimated fees, funding and slippage to fit both a 330 USD cap and current equity minus the 9,850 USD floor. Do not net opposing positions or anticipated profits against this exposure. Use full-layer take-profit orders where supported. Do not assume protective stop orders or partial closes are available; without a confirmed protective stop, loss exits require market closing at the first monitored breach. Open only with reliable monitoring and prompt execution, and flatten before that coverage ends. Never average down, widen loss thresholds, increase notional after losses, or open a trade solely to rescue another position. Retain a losing layer only while its setup, price threshold, holding-time limit and portfolio budget remain valid. Bank realized profits net of costs as buffer without increasing this week's notional or risk cap. A winner and loser may be closed together for a positive combined net result, but never postpone a mandatory exit to achieve this. After two loss-threshold exits, pause new entries for 24 hours and require fresh confirmations.
plan.rationale: Prioritize capital preservation, fixed resources and patience. BTC and ETH remain below their supplied daily moving averages and weekly VWAPs; conditional rebound shorts avoid selling directly into recent lows after broad market weakness. XMR retains relative strength and remains above its daily EMA50, but is below weekly VWAP with weakening momentum, so only a confirmed pullback-and-reclaim long qualifies. Its elevated positive funding requires particular attention to holding costs. All 4h confirmations are future requirements, not signals established by the supplied daily and weekly bars. Use timestamped raw bars and absolute levels rather than inconsistent distance percentages or stale swing labels. Planned leverage is below BTC's 40x, ETH's 25x and XMR's 5x limits. Last week's profitable BTC exit does not establish a reliable edge or justify increasing risk. Remaining flat is appropriate if confirmation or execution safeguards are unavailable.
